take.title_zh: 多模態長文本模型三箭齊發，Agentic AI 全面提速
take.title_en: Three New Frontier Models Signal an Agentic AI Acceleration
take.body_zh:
本週 AI 戰場罕見同時迎來三家巨頭新模型：Meta 推出百萬 token 長文本的 Muse Spark 1.1，主打 agentic 任務並首次開放付費 API；OpenAI 一口氣發布 Sol、Terra、Luna 三款 GPT-5.6 系列模型，依效能與價格分層滿足不同場景；xAI 的 Grok 4.5 同步強打低 token 消耗的知識工作能力。

對設計師與 PM 而言，重點不是誰的 benchmark 最高，而是「多模型分層」正成為主流——高階推理、日常任務、大量低成本呼叫將對應不同模型選擇，產品團隊的 AI 整合策略也需要跟著重新盤點。
take.body_en:
Three major labs shipped new models this week: Meta's Muse Spark 1.1 brings a 1M-token context window and an agentic focus, launching alongside Meta's first-ever paid developer API. OpenAI answered with a three-tier GPT-5.6 lineup, Sol, Terra, and Luna, splitting reasoning power and price. xAI's Grok 4.5 leaned into cheaper, token-efficient knowledge work.

For designers and PMs, the real story is tiering: instead of one flagship model, teams now pick from a stack of options by task and cost. That means product teams should revisit which model powers which feature, not just chase the highest benchmark score.

articles.title_zh: OpenAI 一次發布三款模型：GPT-5.6 系列 Sol／Terra／Luna 上線
articles.title_en: OpenAI Ships Three Models at Once: The GPT-5.6 Lineup
articles.summary_zh: OpenAI 這次不是單一模型更新，而是直接推出 GPT-5.6 系列三款模型：主打高階推理與程式碼、科學運算的 Sol，定價每百萬輸入 token 5 美元、輸出 30 美元；效能接近 GPT-5.5 但成本減半的 Terra；以及鎖定大量低成本高頻任務的 Luna。三款模型分層定位，讓開發者能依場景挑選速度、品質與價格的平衡點，而非只有單一「最強模型」可選。
articles.summary_en: OpenAI's GPT-5.6 release isn't one model but a three-tier lineup. Sol targets top-end reasoning, coding, and science work at $5 per million input tokens and $30 per million output tokens. Terra matches GPT-5.5-level quality at roughly half the cost. Luna is built for fast, cheap, high-volume tasks. The split signals OpenAI is now competing on task-fit and pricing tiers, not just raw benchmark scores, giving developers more levers to balance speed, quality, and cost per use case.
articles.take_zh: 分層發布代表 AI 供應商開始像雲端服務一樣做定價分眾。對產品團隊來說，選型決策會從「用最強模型」變成「幫每個功能配對合適模型」，值得重新盤點 API 成本結構。
articles.take_en: Tiered releases mean AI vendors are pricing like cloud providers now. Product teams should shift from "use the strongest model" to "match each feature to the right tier," and it's a good moment to re-audit API cost structures.

articles.title_zh: Meta 搶進付費 API 戰場：Muse Spark 1.1 主打百萬 token 與 Agentic 能力
articles.title_en: Meta Enters Paid API Race With Agentic Muse Spark 1.1
articles.summary_zh: Meta 發布 Muse Spark 1.1，具備百萬 token 長文本視窗，主打 agentic 任務表現，官方宣稱在 MCP Atlas、JobBench、Humanity's Last Exam 與 Finance Agent V2 等測試上超越 GPT-5.5 與 Opus 4.8。這次同步推出 Meta 史上第一個付費開發者 API（公開預覽，美國限定，贈送 20 美元額度），並支援桌面、瀏覽器、行動裝置的電腦操作能力，以及可平行委派任務的 subagent 機制。
articles.summary_en: Meta's Muse Spark 1.1 pairs a 1M-token context window with an agentic focus, claiming top scores on MCP Atlas, JobBench, Humanity's Last Exam, and Finance Agent V2, ahead of GPT-5.5 and Opus 4.8 by Meta's own benchmarks. The launch also marks Meta's first-ever paid developer API, in public preview with $20 in free credits (US-only for now), plus computer-use support across desktop, browser, and mobile, and parallel subagent delegation for multi-step tasks.
articles.take_zh: Meta 首次開放付費 API，等於正式承認自家模型要走商業化路線，不再只是免費開源策略。若 benchmark 屬實，agentic 電腦操作能力會是接下來設計工具整合的重要變數。
articles.take_en: Meta's first paid API is a real pivot from its open-weights-only playbook toward monetization. If the agentic benchmarks hold up, cross-device computer use could become a serious factor in how design and PM tools integrate AI next.

articles.title_zh: xAI 推出 Grok 4.5：主打低 Token 成本的知識工作能力
articles.title_en: xAI's Grok 4.5 Bets on Cheaper Knowledge Work
articles.summary_zh: xAI 發布 Grok 4.5，強調在程式撰寫與一般知識型工作任務上維持水準的同時，大幅降低所需 token 用量，藉此壓低實際使用成本。這是繼 OpenAI GPT-5.6 系列、Meta Muse Spark 1.1 之後，本週第三家主要 AI 實驗室推出的新模型，顯示競爭焦點正從單純的能力比拼，轉向「同樣品質、更低成本」的效率戰。
articles.summary_en: xAI's Grok 4.5 focuses on maintaining coding and general knowledge-work quality while cutting token consumption, aiming to lower real-world usage costs. It's the third major model launch this week alongside OpenAI's GPT-5.6 lineup and Meta's Muse Spark 1.1, suggesting the competitive frontier is shifting from raw capability claims toward cost-efficiency at comparable quality.
articles.take_zh: 三家同時打「效率牌」，代表 AI 供應鏈的下一階段競爭是成本，而非單純智商分數。對長期依賴 AI 工具的團隊，追蹤 token 成本會跟追蹤模型品質一樣重要。
articles.take_en: Three labs pushing efficiency in the same week signals the next competitive axis is cost, not just raw capability. Teams that rely on AI tools daily should start tracking token spend as closely as model quality.

articles.title_zh: Figma Config 2026：Code Layers、Motion 與 Weave 三大新工具登場
articles.title_en: Figma Config 2026: Code Layers, Motion, and Weave Arrive
articles.summary_zh: Figma 在 Config 2026 大會發布三項重點更新：Code Layers 讓任何圖層一鍵（或用 prompt）轉為可互動的程式碼元件；Motion 讓設計師直接在畫布上用時間軸、關鍵影格與預設值製作動效；Weave 則把生成式 AI 工具整合進畫布本身。整體被視為 Figma 從「設計工具」邁向「AI 驅動產品開發平台」的一次重要跳躍。
articles.summary_en: Figma's Config 2026 introduced three headline features: Code Layers, which turn any design layer into an interactive code component with one click or a prompt; Motion, which brings a full timeline, keyframes, and presets directly onto the canvas; and Weave, which embeds generative AI tools into the canvas itself. Together they mark what many are calling Figma's biggest step yet toward becoming a full AI-driven product development platform, not just a design tool.
articles.take_zh: Code Layers 直接把「設計交付程式碼」這個老問題往前推了一大步，對前端協作流程影響會比表面上更大，值得設計團隊提早評估導入時機。
articles.take_en: Code Layers meaningfully closes the design-to-code gap that's plagued handoff workflows for years. Its downstream impact on front-end collaboration will likely be bigger than it looks, worth evaluating adoption timing early.

articles.title_zh: 【深度】Figma AI 2026 全解析：能做到什麼、還做不到什麼
articles.title_en: Figma AI in 2026: What It Can (and Can't) Do
articles.summary_zh: LogRocket 整理了 Figma 目前所有 AI 功能的完整現況，從畫布內生成、Figma Make 快速原型到自動化工作流程逐一檢視。文中提到一個實際案例：一位 PM 用 Figma Make 打造徽章樣式變化的原型，兩天內完成原本要花六週的工作，說明 AI 工具如何加速非工程角色的產品驗證流程，但也點出目前 AI 生成結果仍需要人工把關與細修的限制。
articles.summary_en: LogRocket's roundup surveys everything Figma's AI can currently do, from in-canvas generation to Figma Make prototyping and workflow automation. One example stands out: a PM used Figma Make to prototype badge variations in two days instead of the usual six weeks, showing how far AI tooling has compressed validation cycles for non-engineering roles. The piece is equally clear-eyed about limits, noting AI output still needs human review and polish before shipping.
articles.take_zh: 「兩天做完六週工作」的案例很吸睛，但重點其實是 PM 角色正在往設計實作靠近。這對團隊分工與 design ops 流程都會是接下來要重新討論的議題。
articles.take_en: The "six weeks to two days" anecdote is eye-catching, but the real story is PMs edging into design execution work. That shift will force teams to revisit role boundaries and design-ops processes.

articles.title_zh: Figma《2026 設計師現況報告》：82.3% UI 設計師仍以 Figma 為主力
articles.title_en: Figma's State of the Designer 2026: Still the Default Hub
articles.summary_zh: 根據 UX Tools 的調查數據，Figma 在 2026 年仍是 82.3% UI 設計師使用的主力工具，其中 82.6% 每週固定使用，穩坐產品開發流程的預設中樞地位。Figma 官方彙整的《設計師現況報告》進一步描繪出設計師在 AI 工具普及後的工作型態變化，包含跨職能協作比重上升、以及設計師參與程式交付環節的比例提高等趨勢。
articles.summary_en: UX Tools survey data cited in Figma's own report shows Figma remains the default hub for UI design in 2026, used by 82.3% of designers, with 82.6% opening it weekly. The State of the Designer 2026 report also tracks how designer workflows are shifting alongside wider AI adoption, including more cross-functional collaboration and a growing share of designers taking on code-adjacent handoff work.
articles.take_zh: 市佔數字本身不令人意外，真正值得留意的是設計師工作範疇正往「懂程式」方向擴張，這會是接下來人才技能盤點的重要參考。
articles.take_en: The market-share number isn't surprising; what matters is designers' scope expanding toward code literacy, a useful signal for skills planning going forward.
